notebooks.title: 几何指标与完整响应
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import control as ct
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import residue
from scipy.optimize import brentq
print('python-control',ct.__version__)
def settling(num,den):
 p=np.roots(den)
 if np.max(p.real)>=-1e-10:return None
 r,ps,_=residue(num,np.polymul(den,[1,0]))
 mask=np.abs(ps)>1e-9;r=r[mask];ps=ps[mask]
 assert np.min([abs(a-b) for i,a in enumerate(ps) for b in ps[i+1:]])>1e-5
 def err(t):return float(np.real(np.sum(r*np.exp(ps*t))))
 def deriv(t):return float(np.real(np.sum(r*ps*np.exp(ps*t))))
 def envelope(t):return float(np.sum(abs(r)*np.exp(ps.real*t)))
 T=1.
 while envelope(T)>.005:T*=2
 def events(dt):
  t=np.linspace(0,T,int(np.ceil(T/dt))+1)
  v=np.real(np.sum((r*ps)[:,None]*np.exp(ps[:,None]*t),axis=0))
  extrema=[brentq(deriv,t[i],t[i+1],xtol=1e-12) for i in range(len(t)-1) if v[i]*v[i+1]<0]
  cuts=[0.]+extrema+[T];cross=[]
  for a,b in zip(cuts[:-1],cuts[1:]):
   for target in [-.02,.02]:
    if (err(a)-target)*(err(b)-target)<0:cross.append(brentq(lambda t:err(t)-target,a,b,xtol=1e-12))
  return sorted(cross),extrema
 dt=min(.02,np.pi/(32*max(1.,np.max(abs(ps.imag)))))
 cross,extrema=events(dt);fine,_=events(dt/2)
 assert len(cross)==len(fine) and np.max(abs(np.asarray(cross)-fine))<1e-9
 ts=cross[-1];peak=max([err(t) for t in [0.]+extrema+[T]]+[0.])
 assert envelope(T)<.005 and T>ts
 return ts,100*peak,T,envelope(T),len(cross)
